title: Elixir of See Invisibility

sources.title: See Invisibility (condition)
markers: {{hatnote|For other versions of this ability, see [[See Invisibility (disambiguation)]].}}

summary: Until Long Rest, detect invisible creatures within 30 ft. They must pass a Dexterity save or lose Invisibility.

fields.Drink: Bonus Action. Consume one bottle. Until Long Rest, detect invisible creatures within 30 ft. They must pass a Dexterity save or lose Invisibility.
fields.Stacking: Replaces other normal elixirs and can be overwritten by another.
fields.Crafting: Combine Suspension of Nothic Eye with any Vitriol.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
